_doc: Family-specific facts used by the inference adapter (not by UI or memory logic). reasoning_toggle = name of the chat-template kwarg that switches thinking on/off (null = no toggle); system_role = whether the chat template accepts a system message; detect = substrings of general.architecture or general.name (lower-case) that identify the family. Verified against the templates shipped in the GGUF files of the catalog entries on 2026-11-02; 'tested' lists the entries actually executed in this project.

families.notes_de: Thinking standardmäßig aus; Umschalten über die Chatvorlage.
Hybride Aufmerksamkeit; Thinking-Umschalter wie Qwen3 (laut Chatvorlage).
Die Gemma-Chatvorlage kennt keine Systemrolle; llama.cpp hängt den Systemtext an die erste Nutzernachricht an.
